subtitle: A boy-Peshwa binds a shattered empire with discipline and dust-covered marches

panels.shot: low-angle wide of a lone young figure before a torn Maratha war-tent on a wind-swept plain
panels.action: Peshwa Madhavrao I stands in simple armor before a great, ripped campaign tent sagging on broken poles, the sky heavy with monsoon clouds over a scattered, weary Maratha camp.

dialogue.text: In the long shadow of Panipat, a sixteen-year-old Peshwa, Madhavrao, must raise a broken tent and a broken state.

i18n.hi: पानीपत की लंबी छाया में, सोलह साल का पेशवा माधवराव, फटा तंबू और टूटी राज्यसत्ता दोनों उठाएगा

panels.shot: somber mid-shot inside a dim Pune hall, with a focus on the young Peshwa’s face
panels.action: Inside a sparse hall in Shaniwar Wada, young Madhavrao sits cross-legged by a low desk, thin and grave, a faint incense haze around him as distant drums echo the memory of Panipat.

dialogue.text: June 1761. Pune is a house of mourning. The Maratha hosts lie far away, buried in the dust of Panipat. Onto this silence steps a boy-Peshwa, Madhavrao, son of the fallen Nanasaheb.

i18n.hi: जून 1761। पुणे शोक का घर है। मराठा सैन्यदल दूर, पानीपत की धूल में दफन हैं। इसी सन्नाटे में कदम रखता है बाल पेशवा माधवराव, गिरे हुए नानासाहेब का बेटा

panels.shot: overhead shot of a table strewn with scrolls, revenue records and maps, Madhavrao small amidst them
panels.action: Madhavrao leans over a wooden table cluttered with palm-leaf records, Persian farmans, and a rough map of the Deccan, his finger resting between Pune and Hyderabad as lamplight pools around him.

dialogue.text: North India is lost. Treasure is gone. Jagirdars hold back revenue. Old allies watch like wolves. Before swords can be drawn again, accounts must be faced and books brought to heel.

i18n.hi: उत्तर भारत हाथ से निकल चुका है। ख़जाने खाली हैं। जागीरदार लगान रोक कर बैठे हैं। पुराने साथी भेड़ियों-सी घूर रहे हैं। तलवारें खिंचने से पहले हिसाब-किताब साफ़ करना होगा

panels.shot: tight mid-shot of Madhavrao dictating to unseen clerks, posture straight, expression controlled but firm
panels.action: Madhavrao sits upright on a low cushion in the diwankhana, hand lifted slightly as he dictates, unseen kayastha clerks around him poised with reed pens over fresh paper.

dialogue.text: From the Peshwa Daftar flow new orders. Old arrears to be collected. Officers to keep written accounts of every rupee and hver horse. No campaign without a ledger, no fief without inspection.

i18n.hi: पेशवा दफ़्तर से नए हुक्म निकलते हैं। पुराने बकाया वसूल होंगे। हर अफ़सर हर रुपये और हर घोड़े का हिसाब लिखेगा। बिना बहीखाते के कोई मोहिम नहीं, बिना जाँच के कोई जागीर नहीं

panels.shot: medium shot of Madhavrao confronting a senior sardar in a courtyard, with guards and clerks watching
panels.action: In a sunlit courtyard, Madhavrao, slight but steady, faces a richly dressed sardar clutching his turban edge, while a clerk holds up a scroll and soldiers stand quietly behind.

dialogue.speaker: peshwa_madhavrao_i
dialogue.text: Service is not a memory of battles, but obedience to today’s orders.

i18n.hi: सेवा का मतलब पुरानी लड़ाइयों की डींगे नहीं, आज के हुक्म मानना है

panels.shot: wide shot of the Nizam’s forces on one side of the Godavari, Maratha forces on the other, dawn light
panels.action: On the banks of the Godavari near Rakshasbhuvan, the Nizam’s ordered ranks gleam on one shore while across the river the Maratha camp stretches, Madhavrao’s banner fluttering above tents and artillery.

dialogue.text: 1763. The Nizam of Hyderabad scents weakness and marches. If Maratha authority fails here, the confederacy will crumble. Madhavrao rides out, not as a grieving son, but as the state itself.

i18n.hi: 1763। निज़ाम-ए-हैदराबाद को कमजोरी की बू आती है और वह चढ़ आता है। यहाँ मराठा दबदबा टूटा, तो पूरा संघ ढह जाएगा। माधवराव निकलता है, शोकाकुल पुत्र नहीं, खुद राज्य बनकर

panels.shot: dynamic side-on wide shot of Madhavrao on horseback addressing cavalry lines before battle
panels.action: Mounted on a dark horse, Madhavrao turns in his saddle to face rows of armored cavalry and infantry, his arm extended in a measured gesture, the dusty plain of Rakshasbhuvan behind him.

dialogue.speaker: peshwa_madhavrao_i
dialogue.text: Today the Deccan will see if Panipat broke our courage, or only our bodies.

i18n.hi: आज दक्खन देखेगा कि पानीपत ने हमारा हौसला तोड़ा, या सिर्फ़ हमारे शरीर

panels.shot: wide bird’s-eye view of the battlefield, with Maratha lines pressing and Nizam’s troops withdrawing in the distance
panels.action: From high above, disciplined Maratha formations surge forward in neat blocks while, across the field, the Nizam’s lines bend and drift back toward the river, dust clouds veiling their retreat.

dialogue.text: At Rakshasbhuvan the boy-Peshwa fights like a careful accountant. No wild charges, no wasteful glory. The Nizam yields ground. The message spreads across the Deccan—the Maratha tent stands again.

i18n.hi: राक्षसभुवन में बाल पेशवा हिसाबी मुनीम की तरह लड़ता है। न बेपरवाह धावे, न फिजूल बहादुरी। निज़ाम पीछे हटता है। खबर दक्खन में फैलती है—मराठा तंबू फिर तन गया

panels.shot: intimate mid-shot inside a small campaign tent at night, Madhavrao coughing softly while reading
panels.action: By a flickering oil lamp in a modest tent, Madhavrao pauses, hand to his chest from a light cough, then bends again over a stack of reports, his armor set aside for plain cotton robes.

dialogue.text: Illness bites early. Tuberculosis gnaws at his lungs, but he cuts no rest for himself. Even in the field, he reads reports, checks receipts, and writes to far-off sardars.

i18n.hi: बीमारी जल्दी चढ़ बैठती है। क्षय फेफड़ों को कुतरता है, पर वो खुद को रियायत नहीं देता। मैदान में भी रिपोर्ट पढ़ता है, रसीदें जांचता है, दूर बैठे सरदारों को खत लिखता है

panels.shot: wide shot of a rugged Mysore frontier fort in the distance, Maratha army encamped in the foreground
panels.action: On a rocky hill in Mysore country, a stubborn fort rises above forest, while below in orderly rows the Maratha tents, guns, and baggage animals line the ground in precise formation.

dialogue.text: In the south, new powers stir. Mysore’s rulers harden their domains. Madhavrao pushes campaigns into these frontiers, less for conquest than to signal that Maratha claims are no empty ink on maps.

i18n.hi: दक्षिण में नई ताकतें करवट लेती हैं। मैसूर के हाकिम अपने इलाक़े सख़्त बनाते हैं। माधवराव इन सरहदों तक मुहिमें धकेलता है, ज़्यादा फ़तह के लिए नहीं, यह दिखाने को कि मराठा दावा नक़्शों की स्याही भर नहीं

panels.shot: mid-shot of Madhavrao meeting local chiefs at a field durbar, scribes at the edge recording
panels.action: Under a large tree near Dharwad, Madhavrao sits at a simple field durbar carpet, speaking to a circle of local chiefs as scribes at the edge write down agreed taxes and obligations.

dialogue.text: At Dharwad and beyond, he bargains, threatens, and reasons. Tribute is fixed, grain assessments tightened, local chiefs bound by written bonds. The empire is slowly stitched not by fear, but by enforceable paper.

i18n.hi: धरवाड़ और आगे, वह मोलभाव करता है, धमकाता है, समझाता है। नज़राना तय होता है, अनाज का बाँट सख़्त होता है, देसी नायक लिखित बंधों से बाँधे जाते हैं। साम्राज्य धीरे-धीरे डर से नहीं, लागू काग़ज़ से सिलता है

panels.shot: medium shot of Madhavrao and a senior officer over a chest of coins and a muster roll
panels.action: In a granary-turned-office, Madhavrao stands beside a chest of coins and a muster roll laid open, while a weathered officer bows slightly, hands folded, as if being quietly reprimanded.

dialogue.speaker: peshwa_madhavrao_i
dialogue.text: If your horse does not exist on paper, it does not exist in pay.

i18n.hi: तुम्हारा घोड़ा काग़ज़ पर नहीं, तो तनख़्वाह में भी नहीं

panels.shot: wide shot of Shaniwar Wada courtyard bustling with clerks, soldiers, and petitioners
panels.action: The courtyard of Shaniwar Wada is alive with motion—clerks carry bundles of records, soldiers wait in lines for orders, villagers clutch petitions, as Madhavrao walks through with a small escort, observing silently.

dialogue.text: Under his eye, the Peshwa Daftar becomes a war-room of paper. Routes are planned, grain flows measured, jagirs shuffled. Power is no longer a mere charge of horsemen, but a discipline of information.

i18n.hi: उसकी नज़र में पेशवा दफ़्तर काग़ज़ का जंग का मैदान बन जाता है। राहें तय होती हैं, अन्न का बहाव नापा जाता है, जागीरें उलटी-पलटी जाती हैं। ताकत अब सिर्फ़ घुड़सवारों का धावा नहीं, खबर और हिसाब का अनुशासन है

panels.shot: wide shot suggesting distance: in the foreground Madhavrao with a letter, in the background a faded vision of Delhi’s skyline
panels.action: Holding an opened letter in Pune, Madhavrao looks out toward the horizon, while behind him in a pale, dreamlike overlay rises the silhouette of Delhi’s walls and domes.

dialogue.text: By 1771, Mahadji Scindia rides north. In Delhi, Shah Alam II is restored under Maratha protection. The old Mughal throne now leans on Maratha spears, even as the Punjab remains beyond their grasp.

i18n.hi: 1771 तक महादजी शिंदे उत्तर की ओर कूच करते हैं। दिल्ली में शाह आलम द्वितीय मराठा साये में फिर गद्दीनशीन होता है। पुराना मुगल सिंहासन अब मराठा भालों पर टिका है, भले पंजाब अभी भी हाथ से बाहर है

panels.shot: close-up on Madhavrao’s face, older and more drawn, eyes thoughtful, a faint sheen of sweat
panels.action: A close view shows Madhavrao seated indoors, face thinner, eyes ringed but steady, a subtle sweat on his brow as he listens to a report, one hand resting lightly on his chest.

dialogue.text: Victory carries its own shadows. Conflict with his uncle Raghunathrao gnaws at the court. His body weakens even as his authority strengthens. He has no time to make peace with either.

i18n.hi: फ़तह अपने साए लेकर आती है। मामा रघुनाथराव से टकराव दरबार को काटता रहता है। जिस्म कमज़ोर, पर रौब और बढ़ता है। न अपने दिल से सुलह को वक़्त है, न दरबार से

panels.shot: soft interior mid-shot of Madhavrao on a low bed, speaking quietly to a trusted attendant
panels.action: Reclining on a simple low bed, wrapped in a light shawl, Madhavrao speaks calmly to a seated attendant at his side, the open window behind him showing the pale light of an early morning.

dialogue.speaker: peshwa_madhavrao_i
dialogue.text: Tell them: no man’s name is bigger than the state’s work.

i18n.hi: उन्हें कहो: किसी आदमी का नाम, राज्य के काम से बड़ा नहीं

panels.shot: wide contemplative shot of the Shaniwar Wada and Pune skyline under a gentle dusk, Madhavrao’s empty balcony visible
panels.action: At dusk, the silhouette of Shaniwar Wada rises over Pune’s clustered roofs; Madhavrao’s balcony stands empty, its railing catching the last light, as smoke from a distant pyre thins into the sky.

dialogue.text: In 1772, Madhavrao dies at just twenty-seven. He leaves no new Panipat of triumph, no vast new provinces—but he leaves something harder to build: a state that can stand upright again.

i18n.hi: 1772 में, बस सत्ताईस की उम्र में, माधवराव चला जाता है। वह न कोई नया विजयी पानीपत छोड़ता है, न नई विशाल सूबहें—पर छोड़ता है वह जो ज़्यादा कठिन था: एक ऐसा राज्य, जो फिर सीधा खड़ा हो सके

panels.shot: symbolic wide shot of a once-torn tent now fully raised and orderly Maratha camp around it at sunrise
panels.action: On an open plain, a large campaign tent that was once torn now stands fully raised and straight, guy-ropes taut, with an orderly Maratha camp stretching out around it in the clear light of sunrise.

dialogue.text: His legacy is not a legend of heroic last stands, but of ledgers, discipline, and patient marches. In the age after Panipat, Madhavrao showed that recovery begins when grief hardens into work.

i18n.hi: उसकी याद आख़िरी वीरता की दास्तान नहीं, बल्कि बहीखातों, अनुशासन और धीरज भरी चढ़ाइयों की है। पानीपत के बाद के ज़माने में माधवराव ने दिखाया कि उबरना तब शुरू होता है, जब शोक काम में ढल जाता है

title_i18n.hi: माधवराव ने फिर खड़ा किया फटा तंबू

subtitle_i18n.en: A boy-Peshwa binds a shattered empire with discipline and dust-covered marches
subtitle_i18n.hi: बाल पेशवा ने अनुशासन और धूल भरी यात्राओं से बिखरा साम्राज्य फिर बाँधा
